title: Latina/e lesbian archival praxis and memory work: a plática/roda de conversa with Malflora Collective.
abstract: Malflora Collective is a digital memory project dedicated to preserving the everyday lives, memories, and legacies of Latina/e lesbians through the publication of a podcast and magazine. In this article, members from Malflora Collective examine the nontraditional and community-based archival practices that Latina/e lesbians engage in, arguing that our memory work is rooted in collectivity, lived experience, and cultural reclamation as a form of decolonial praxis. We also explore how digital spaces provide opportunities for transnational engagement, solidarity, and discourse, while at the same time these spaces remain highly contested.
